clue.text: Countryside interrupting outcome?

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the middle of the other, cutting it open
the word out read as an adjective meaning wrong or astray, so the letters of come are rearranged

parts.note: a cricket or football side is an eleven, XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A question about what happens when the countryside gets in the way of a result.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue splits its own words: 'Countryside' gives the definition Country and the piece side, and 'outcome' gives the indicator out and the fodder come. MECO (come, rearranged) is cut open by XI.
explanation.definitionFit: Mexico is a nation in North America, a straightforward example of a country.

clue.text: Drink rings bell in Market Road

parts.note: port is a fortified wine

indicators.note: the word bell sits inside the pair of rings

parts.note: each ring is the round letter O, so two rings give two Os
taken as written

explanation.surface: A drinker sounds a bell somewhere along a street with a market.
explanation.walkthrough: Portobello Road is the London street famous for its antiques and street market.
explanation.definitionFit: The named London street with the well-known Saturday market completes the phrase Portobello Road.

clue.text: Party-giver accepting clipped old coin for feast

indicators.note: the host takes another piece inside it

parts.note: the person throwing a party is its host

indicators.note: clipped means the end of the coin's name is cut off

parts.note: a groat was an old English silver coin worth four pence

explanation.surface: Someone throwing a party takes a trimmed antique coin in payment for a banquet.
explanation.walkthrough: Clipping coins, shaving metal from their edges, was a real old crime, so 'clipped' reads naturally in the surface while signalling the lost last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A hog roast is a party meal where a whole pig is cooked on a spit, a kind of feast.

clue.text: Move aimlessly and pick up something useful

parts.note: to gad about is to wander without purpose
to get something is to pick it up or obtain it

explanation.surface: Wander about and collect a handy item along the way.
explanation.definitionFit: A gadget is a small handy device, a useful contrivance.

clue.text: Strategy requiring instrument to keep quiet

indicators.note: the instrument holds the quiet letter within it

parts.note: a gamelan is an Indonesian percussion ensemble, here treated as an instrument
p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

explanation.surface: A tactic that demands a musical instrument be kept silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A game plan is a planned course of action, a strategy for achieving an aim.

clue.text: Let off school during engagement

indicators.note: the school comes in the middle of the engagement, inside it

parts.note: a date is an appointment or engagement
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: Pupils are released from school while having an appointment elsewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: To let off a bomb or firework is to set it exploding.

clue.text: Image of record artist-in-residence curtailed

indicators.note: the record and the artist go inside the shortened residence
curtailed means having its tail, the last letter, cut off

parts.note: a home is a residence
a log is a written record
RA is a Royal Academician, a recognised artist

explanation.surface: A picture recording a painter's stay as artist-in-residence, cut short.
explanation.walkthrough: The set phrase artist-in-residence has to be broken up: its middle word 'in' is the container signal, and 'curtailed' applies to the residence.
explanation.definitionFit: A hologram is a three-dimensional picture made with laser light, so an image.

clue.text: Purveyor of pork pies raised by bird

indicators.note: in a down entry, raised means the word is written upward, backwards

parts.note: pork pies is rhyming slang for lies, so their purveyor is a teller of lies

explanation.surface: A seller of pork pies is lifted up by a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: Pork pies is Cockney rhyming slang for lies. 'raised' turns LIAR upwards in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: A rail is a marsh bird, a relative of the coot and corncrake.

clue.text: Thatcher dispatching soldier's fount of wisdom

indicators.note: dispatching means sending away, so the soldier is removed

parts.note: Maggie was the familiar name for Margaret Thatcher, the British prime minister
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A roof-thatcher sends away a soldier who was a source of wisdom.
explanation.walkthrough: Thatcher looks like a roofer but means Margaret Thatcher, Britain's prime minister 1979-90, nicknamed Maggie.
explanation.definitionFit: A mage is a magician or learned sage, someone full of wisdom.

clue.text: Fabled compiler's not entirely stupid

parts.note: the setter refers to himself, so compiler's means my

indicators.note: not entirely means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: thick means stupid

explanation.surface: The setter admits to being legendary and only partly dim.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fabled exists in legend or fable, as does anything mythic.

clue.text: Outside left looking hard at bird

indicators.note: the staring goes on the outside, around the letter for left

parts.note: staring is looking hard and fixedly

explanation.surface: A left winger gazes intently at a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: Outside left is a football position, but here 'Outside' wraps STARING around L.
explanation.definitionFit: The starling is a common speckled songbird.

clue.text: Cooking implement getting first-rate cooker's first-rate backing, inducing non-specific neurosis

parts.note: a pan is a cooking utensil
top means excellent, first-rate
a hob is the top of a cooker

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the second first-rate is read in reverse

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the 1 taken as the letter I

explanation.surface: A pan used with a top-quality cooker somehow brings on a general anxiety.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first-class) is read with 1 as I, and 'backing' turns it to IA.
explanation.definitionFit: Pantophobia is a fear of everything, an anxiety with no particular object.

clue.text: Art of Chinese sleuths raised aquatic transport

parts.note: the Han are the main ethnic group of China

indicators.note: in a down light raised means written upward, backwards

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British detective branch
a raft is a simple floating craft

explanation.surface: Chinese detectives lift a boat as a work of art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns CID into DIC in this down light.
explanation.definitionFit: Handicraft is skilled making by hand, an applied craft or art.

clue.text: Renown of big eater eating what's left to eat, initially

indicators.note: eating means the glutton takes the remainder inside

parts.note: a pig is a glutton
the rest is what remains

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word eat

explanation.surface: A glutton's fame comes from finishing off the leftovers.
explanation.walkthrough: A big eater is a crossword pig; the remainder goes in just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Prestige is high standing, the fame or reputation someone earns.

clue.text: Misconstrued Fay's plea to hedge bets

indicators.note: misconstrued means wrongly put together, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone called Fay was misunderstood when she pleaded to cover her bets.
explanation.definitionFit: To play safe is to avoid risk, like hedging bets so as not to lose heavily.

clue.text: Misguidedly train as practitioner of 12

indicators.note: misguidedly means led astray, so the letters go wrong way round

explanation.surface: Someone wrongly trains as a craftsman.
explanation.definitionFit: 12 is HANDICRAFT, and an artisan is a skilled craft worker who practises it.

clue.text: Shady lady's second instrument

parts.note: the trumpet is a brass instrument

explanation.surface: A disreputable woman owns a second musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Strumpet is an old word for a prostitute or loose woman, someone of doubtful reputation.

clue.text: Sideways, subsequently, on a plate

parts.note: later means subsequently
an L-plate shows a learner driver in Britain, so plate gives L

explanation.surface: Something set to one side later, served on a dish.
explanation.walkthrough: British learner drivers display a red L on a white plate, hence plate for L.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral means to do with the side, moving sideways.

clue.text: Split a horny model's nose job

indicators.note: to model is to shape, so these letters are shaped anew

explanation.surface: A randy model gets her nose surgically divided.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhinoplasty is plastic surgery on the nose, informally called a nose job.

clue.text: Quit application, finally causing ferment

parts.note: to quit a place is to leave it

indicators.note: finally means taking the last letter of application

explanation.surface: Abandoning a job application ends up stirring unrest.
explanation.definitionFit: To leaven dough is to make it ferment and rise with yeast; figuratively it means to pervade and change.

clue.text: Improvised performance in musical, back to front

indicators.note: the back letter of the word moves to its front

parts.note: Cats is the Andrew Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: A made-up act in a stage show, done the wrong way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back to front' moves the final S of CATS to the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Scat is jazz singing improvised with nonsense syllables.

clue.text: Island's translation of Bible into German? Yes!

indicators.note: the Bible version goes inside the German word

parts.note: ja is the German for yes
AV is the Authorized Version, the King James translation of the Bible

explanation.surface: An island where the Bible is being put into German, to joyful approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Java is the populous Indonesian island on which Jakarta stands.

clue.text: Blade's about to become increasingly promiscuous?

parts.note: c (circa) means about
to lay more, in slang, is to sleep around more and more

explanation.surface: A sword is about to start sleeping around more.
explanation.definitionFit: A claymore is a large two-edged Scottish broadsword.

clue.text: Film: Daddy's Girl

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
Tina is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A movie title like Daddy's Girl.
explanation.definitionFit: A patina is a thin coating or layer that forms on a surface, such as a film on bronze.

clue.text: Dater's compromise?

parts.note: read as wordplay, trade with off as its anagram signal rearranges to give the clue word dater

explanation.surface: A romantic dater wonders about settling for less.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a clue, TRADE OFF says rearrange TRADE, which makes DATER: the answer is the wordplay for the clue word.
explanation.definitionFit: A trade-off is a balance struck between competing aims, giving up one thing for another.

clue.text: Never, ever, ever restricting worship

indicators.note: the words confine the answer inside them, holding it within

explanation.surface: An emphatic refusal ever to limit devotion.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the gaps: neveR EVERE ver.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere is to regard with deep awe, to venerate or adore.
